title: Comparison of BMD Measurement by DEXA to BeamMed Speed-of-Sound Measurement at Forearm in Patients With Gaucher Disease
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to compare the accuracy and comparability and secondarily to assess the values achieved by measurement of the forearm BMD by DXA and SOS by BeamMed, relative to standard DXA evaluations at the FN and LS.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age: \>18
* Gaucher disease type 1
* Able to undergo a DEXA test

Exclusion Criteria:

* Minors
